wages.text: His campaign platform proposes increasing the minimum wage so full-time workers can support their families.
wages.quote: Implement a minimum wage increase so that full-time workers can achieve financial stability and support their families.

schools.text: His campaign platform calls for increased funding and resources for public schools.
schools.quote: Prioritize increased funding for public schools to improve facilities, classroom resources, and educational programs, ensuring every student has access to quality education.

safety.text: His platform proposes guiding young people away from incarceration and toward education and careers.
safety.quote: Create pathways that guide youth away from the prison pipeline and towards meaningful careers, ensuring a brighter future for all.

immigration.text: His platform proposes faster case processing and a clear process for people following immigration law.
immigration.quote: Create a clear, streamlined process so individuals who are following the law can move through the system efficiently

health.text: His platform proposes improving enrollment in available health programs and enhancing Medicare services.
health.quote: Focus on reducing the approximately nine percent of South Carolinians who are uninsured by enhancing outreach and enrollment efforts for available health programs.

energy.text: His campaign platform supports renewable energy policies to reduce emissions and legislation aimed at net-zero greenhouse gas emissions.
energy.quote: Supporting legislation that aims for net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by a specified target year.

tax.text: Wilson says he supports tax cuts and opposes policies that could lead to higher taxes.
tax.quote: we must continue to protect American prosperity by avoiding actions today that could lead to hyperinflation, high interest rates, and higher taxes in the future.

wages.text: Wilson reintroduced legislation to make union dues voluntary and said workers and employers should negotiate employment terms.
wages.quote: South Carolina is a right-to-work state, and we have seen tremendous economic growth by expanding economic freedom for our businesses.

trade.text: He voted yes on passage of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement Implementation Act.
trade.quote: Vote Question: On Passage United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement Implementation Act

schools.text: Wilson says he supports school choice and local governance of schools.
schools.quote: Every child is unique, which is why I support school choice and local governance of schools.

immigration.text: Wilson says immigration laws should be strongly enforced and opposes amnesty for undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: Until the appropriate laws already on the books are strongly enforced, illegal immigrants will continue to pour across our borders and weaken our national security.

guns.text: Wilson said he introduced legislation to block an ATF rule on pistol braces and argued for protecting gun owners’ rights.
guns.quote: So I introduced the PISTOL Act to block the ATF from redefining pistol braces as short-barreled rifles.

abortion.text: Wilson has publicly supported legislation to protect unborn life, including the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act.
abortion.quote: I am grateful to stand with my colleagues in Congress to defend the right to life for the unborn.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly agreed that biological males should not participate in women’s sports or use women’s spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces

cannabis.text: He voted no on passage of the MORE Act.
cannabis.quote: Vote Question: On Passage MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay

health.text: He selected a position retaining Medicare and Medicaid while opposing additional taxpayer-funded health programs.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary.

energy.text: Wilson supports an all-of-the-above energy strategy that he says lowers costs and includes domestic energy production.
energy.quote: He is a leading voice for expanding energy infrastructure—including small modular reactors, next-generation nuclear technology, and responsible domestic production.

voting.text: He strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification.
